nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q \ge 1$ a natural number and $g \in G$ with $g^q = 1$; for $h \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $h^a$ for $h^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. For all $x, k, r \in \mathbb{Z}/q$, with public key $y = g^x$, the honest transcript $(g^k, r, rx + k)$ is accepted, that is, $g^{rx + k} (y^r)^{-1} = g^k$.
nodes.title: Completeness of the Schnorr identification scheme

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q$ a natural number and $g, y \in G$ (the base and the public key); for $h \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $h^a$ for $h^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a$ is the representative of $a$ in $\{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ (and $\bar a = |a|$ when $q = 0$, so that $\mathbb{Z}/q = \mathbb{Z}$). The verifier accepts a transcript $(I, r, s)$ with $I \in G$ and $r, s \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ when…
nodes.title: Schnorr verifier's acceptance condition

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q$ a prime and $g, y \in G$ with $g^q = 1$ and $y^q = 1$; for $h \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $h^a$ for $h^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. Let $I \in G$ and $r, s, r', s' \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ with $r \ne r'$, and suppose both transcripts $(I, r, s)$ and $(I, r', s')$ are accepted, that is, $g^s (y^r)^{-1} = I$ and…
nodes.title: Special soundness

nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a natural number. For $r, s, r', s' \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ (the challenges and answers of two transcripts), the extracted exponent is $(s - s')(r - r')^{-1} \in \mathbb{Z}/q$, where $u^{-1}$ is the inverse of $u$ in $\mathbb{Z}/q$ when $u$ is a unit (and, otherwise, a conventional element of $\mathbb{Z}/q$ depending on $u$). For $q$ prime and $r \ne r'$ it is $(s - s')/(r - r')$.
nodes.title: Schnorr knowledge extractor

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q \ge 1$ and $g \in G$; for $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $g^a$ for $g^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. For a secret key $x$, prover randomness $k$ and challenge $r$, all in $\mathbb{Z}/q$, the honest transcript is the element $(g^k, r, rx + k)$ of $G \times \mathbb{Z}/q \times \mathbb{Z}/q$.
nodes.title: Honest Schnorr transcript

nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a natural number. For a secret key $x$, prover randomness $k$ and challenge $r$, all in $\mathbb{Z}/q$, the prover's answer is $s = rx + k \in \mathbb{Z}/q$.
nodes.title: Schnorr prover's response

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q \ge 1$ and $g, y \in G$; for $h \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $h^a$ for $h^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. For a challenge $r$ and an answer $s$ in $\mathbb{Z}/q$, the simulated transcript is the element $(g^s (y^r)^{-1}, r, s)$ of $G \times \mathbb{Z}/q \times \mathbb{Z}/q$.
nodes.title: Simulated Schnorr transcript

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q \ge 1$ and $g, y \in G$; for $h \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $h^a$ for $h^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. The simulator's distribution is the law of the simulated transcript $(g^s (y^r)^{-1}, r, s)$ when $(r, s)$ is uniform on $\mathbb{Z}/q \times \mathbb{Z}/q$; it uses only $g$ and the public key $y$.
nodes.title: Schnorr simulator

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q \ge 1$ and $g \in G$ with $g^q = 1$; for $h \in G$ and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $h^a$ for $h^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. For every secret key $x \in \mathbb{Z}/q$, with public key $y = g^x$, the honest transcript $(g^k, r, rx + k)$ with $(k, r)$ uniform on $\mathbb{Z}/q \times \mathbb{Z}/q$ has the same distribution as the…
nodes.title: Perfect honest-verifier zero knowledge

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a commutative group, $q \ge 1$ and $g \in G$; for $a \in \mathbb{Z}/q$ write $g^a$ for $g^{\bar a}$, where $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, q - 1\}$ is the representative of $a$. For a secret key $x \in \mathbb{Z}/q$, this is the law of the honest transcript $(g^k, r, rx + k)$ when $(k, r)$ is uniform on $\mathbb{Z}/q \times \mathbb{Z}/q$.
nodes.title: Distribution of honest Schnorr transcripts

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
